about: A table check that names the push lane but is no run of it is not credited, so lane-unrun fires: a CI-only row (named, never run locally), a command whose program is not node (a shell wrapping it, npx), another checker mode (--closed-beads, --list-rules, --phase-close) and a checker under another name, and an `npm run` check whose package script is no one command (a chain, a pipe, || true, a quoted sh -c, a missing script or one in another directory's package.json)
